limitations: Synthetic mono D3D11 fixture; no EXD/headset FPS or transparent interception claim.
GPU timestamps bracket ordinary prepass, extra mapped prepass, shading, hardware MSAA resolve, reconstruction and conventional consumer.
GPU timestamp/barrier overhead remains; compilation/allocation/readback and CPU waits are outside timed sequences.
CPU record time covers immediate calls and may include queue backpressure, not total CPU frame time.
Restricted no-discard, no-custom-depth, trivial vertex shaders and D32Float/RGBA8; no EXD stencil/HDR/stereo validation.
Physical mapped MSAA source remains mapped; final conventional output does not repair later source uses.
